changes.before: Kickoff call scheduled by Implementation Consultant.
changes.after: Kickoff: Implementation Consultant reviews the AE's "Deal Closed" handoff record and schedules a kickoff call within 5 business days of contract signature.
Discovery: Consultant confirms configuration requirements (e.g., NexFlow batch/lot tracking, NexConnect data sources) directly with the customer.
Configuration & data migration: Consultant (or Solutions Architect, for custom integrations) configures the tenant and migrates initial data.
Training: Consultant delivers admin and end-user training sessions.

changes.before: Project Lead provides final go-live sign-off.
changes.after: Go-live sign-off: The Implementation Manager provides final go-live approval after Consultant confirms all discovery items are resolved.

changes.before: Handoff to Account Management (note: the "Account Management" function referenced here was reorganized into the Customer Success department in 2024; this document was not updated to reflect that change prior to being superseded).
changes.after: Handoff to Customer Success: Implementation Manager and the assigned Customer Success Manager hold a formal handoff call; open items are logged in the account record.

history_notes_in_active_documents.heading: VERSION HISTORY NOTE — Known Conflict
history_notes_in_active_documents.text: An earlier version of new-hire onboarding guidance (see archived_new_hire_security_training_v1_ARCHIVED.md, Version 1.0, effective 2022-08-01) stated that security training must be completed "within 30 days" of start date. This current document (Version 3.0, effective 2025-06-01) supersedes that guidance with the 10 working days requirement above. The 2025-06-01 version is current; the 30-day figure should not be used going forward, but it may still appear in older printed materials or an employee's memory of what they were told during a hiring process before mid-2025.

history_notes_in_active_documents.heading: VERSION HISTORY NOTE
history_notes_in_active_documents.text: Version 1.0 (Effective 2023-06-01, now superseded) of this document referred to the final approval role as "Project Lead." As of Version 2.0 (2025-03-01), this role is titled "Implementation Manager." Some archived training materials and older customer correspondence templates still reference "Project Lead" — treat as equivalent.
